question: In three fixed native-grid patches, how much archived 500 hPa vector forecast error survives three-to-one block averaging, and does L12 beat L6 and its own seasonal baseline?
level: External retrospective development diagnostic, no native semantic admission
patch_geometry: 9 by 9 native 2.5-degree nodes, offsets -4 through 4; lat descending, lon ascending. Chosen around earlier named regions, not identical to their earlier broader boxes. No interpolation or value-based selection.
weights: Exact spherical cell areas at native centers with latitude edges +/-1.25 degrees, normalized inside each patch; both east/north components share each weight.
coarse_operator: Weighted 3 by 3 child average into 3 by 3 blocks; orthogonal lift in the declared coordinate-component metric. Coarse and residual energies add.
spectral_operator: Unitary two-dimensional length-9 tensor DFT of sqrt(area weight) times component error. Bands max(abs(k))=0,1,2..4. For boundary sensitivity only, orthonormal type-II DCT high band max(index)>=3. These are different boundary conventions, not equal filters or spherical degree bands.
assumptions: Saved backtest arrays contain decoded total wind coefficients, not standardized anomalies; prior frozen check independently reconstructed global errors.
Existing evaluator order and local east/north basis match archived channels. Hash-pin retained; no new independent spherical evaluator implemented.
Reanalysis is a comparison reference, not direct observation or proof of physical truth.
Local vector components use their declared east/north frame; block averaging does not add parallel transport.
cross_domain: Apply the factorized length-9 address spectrum and ternary block projection on two native spatial axes; retain time and vector component labels. Do not fabricate four physical axes or identify this spectrum with spherical harmonics.
protected: Frozen archives and production forecasts unchanged
No retraining or model selection using evaluation errors
Missing or changed private inputs return Unavailable or Failure; never claim a fresh Pass
source_authenticity_reservation: The user questions authenticity of the entire data chain, not only display or processing. Hash agreement and same-source consistency do not resolve that concern. No independent source replication or physical authenticity verification is performed; every result is conditional on these frozen inputs.
scope: 1979-2014 original fitting, 2015-2019 original validation, already exposed 2020-2025 development backtests. Aggregate diagnostics only; no operational forecast, teleconnection significance, typhoon or ENSO attribution.

budget.enforcement: Streaming input hashes; fixed input sizes and 24 cases; parent wall timeout, worker POSIX CPU/address-space limits, persistent private launch ledger. No automatic retry; only one unchanged replay.

acceptance: Pass requires pinned sources, exact time/grid agreement, all finite patch values and numerical energy identities. A model may be worse than its baseline.
data_acknowledgement: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 data supplied by NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA. Independent derived diagnostics; no NOAA endorsement.
